request.questionText: Which of the following statements is accurate with respect to statistical uncertainty? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The concept of "statistical uncertainty" is useful in every application of data science.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The concept of "statistical uncertainty" has a much more narrow definition compared to the general concept of "uncertainty" as relating to what is unknown.

choices.label: C
choices.text: In statistics, to be “certain” means that your results arerepeatableunder idealized conditions. Your results are considered "uncertain" if they fluctuate upon repeated observations.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Any measure of "statistical uncertainty" will overstate the amount of "real-world uncertainty" that is, in fact, associated with the phenomenon of interest.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Any measure of "statistical uncertainty" will understate the amount of "real-world uncertainty" that is, in fact, associated with the phenomenon of interest.
